note: Operator plans used to check the geometry. None of them is open data, so they are linked here and never copied into the repository (copies read for the checks lived only in the git-ignored .cache/plans/). The wider photo and plan collection is in bern-research/references/ (operator_links.json, photo_records.json). 'plan_checks' is a hand-made record of what was read off each plan on 2026-11-21; build_focus.py copies it onto the matching boarding edges as 'plan_check'.

plan_checks.position_check: Automated test = nearest named OSM street to the atlas kerb point, compared with the street the plan draws the kerb on. Equal for E, F (Bahnhofplatz), I (Schauplatzgasse), J, K1 (Christoffelgasse), L, M, Q (Bubenbergplatz), N (Schwanengasse). A to D: OSM names the carriageway through the square 'Bubenbergplatz' where the plan labels the island area 'Bahnhofplatz' (same place). G, H, Z: nearest named OSM street is 'Bahnhofplatz' at 9 to 20 m while the plan draws them at Bollwerk (G, H) and at the Neuengasse corner (Z): same junction, not a strict match.
plan_checks.symbols: the plan draws lift + stairs/escalator symbols on Bahnhofplatz next to Heiliggeistkirche, at Kante A, at Neuengasse and at the Welle (Schanzenstrasse); OSM has lift and stair/escalator features at all four places (levels -1/0 at Bahnhofplatz and Neuengasse, 0/1 at the Welle)

plan_checks.position_check: the plan only labels the block 'Kanten R bis Y' at the PostAuto station above the tracks; single kerbs are not drawn

Automated test = nearest named OSM street to the atlas kerb point: equal to the plan's street for all 9 letters (A, B Kornhausplatz; C, D Kramgasse; E Theaterplatz; F, K Casinoplatz; G Kochergasse; H Amthausgasse). The lines per kerb printed on the plan equal the Stadt Bern 'Nummer_nach' lists for A to H.
Automated test = nearest named OSM street to the atlas kerb point: 'Max-Daetwyler-Platz' for A to D (13 to 19 m), as on the plan; order A, B/C, D from north to south agrees.
plan_checks.symbols: one lift at the western underpass of the rail station, pedestrian accesses at Stauffacherstrasse in the east

plan_checks.position_check: Automated test = nearest named OSM street to the atlas kerb point: 'Rosalia-Wenger-Platz' for E and F, as on the plan. G (Hoffstrasse) is not on the 2025 plan.
